comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: Iran can feel incredibly cheap to tourists - but painfully expensive to locals. Is "cheap travel"sometimes just another side of economic hardship?

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: That’s a really important point. What feels “cheap” to a visitor can sometimes reflect a very different economic reality for the people who live there. Travel becomes much more meaningful when we look beyond prices and try to understand everyday life for locals. Thanks for bringing this perspective to the discussion. 🙏
